summary: The statement and proof are correct. The common intersection is a full-dimensional origin-symmetric convex body; density scaling validly realizes the same translated tube at every input mass; the accepted parity repacking theorem yields exactly the stated output masses and centers; ordered-pair counting proves mass conservation; and Brunn-Minkowski, AM-GM, and Cauchy-Schwarz give the claimed target-fiber quarter-cap, including diagonal and boundary cases.
